title: Jamaican Beef Hash
description: A keto twist on the classic hash, with the bold flavors of Jamaica. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
3. Add the Jamaican hash, bell pepper, onion, and garlic to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
4. Add the cayenne pepper and stir to combine.
5. Season with Hawaiian salt to taste.
6. Serve the beef and hash mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
